subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the shear wall between Structural General Notes

messages.text: The shear wall reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Structural Detail 3/S502. This is becoming a priority on our end; we'd appreciate a prompt response. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is holding the concrete placement for this pour. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible.

Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Structural Detail 3/S502; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is holding the concrete placement for this pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- #6 dowels at 12" o.c. -- apply at every shear wall on this level, not just the one called out in Structural General Notes S-001?
